metadata.article_title: Core services, etc., of information utilities.

article.title: Core services, etc., of information utilities.
article.content: An information utility shall provide such services as may be specified including core services to any person if such person complies with the terms and conditions as may be specified by regulations.
article.html:
213Core services, etc., of information utilities.

Section 213 · Part IV · Chapter V · page 136 of the Act

An information utility shall provide such services as may be specified including core services to any person if such person complies with the terms and conditions as may be specified by regulations.
